text:
Counting the berries on the plate: about 6 raspberries (some are broken pieces) and 4 blackberries, plus a few small yellow crumbs.

Mass estimate:
- Raspberries: about 6 at roughly 3–4 g each, so about 20 g.
- Blackberries: 4 at roughly 7 g each, so about 28 g.
- Crumbs: about 2 g.
- Total: about 50 g.

Energy estimate:
- Raspberries: 20 g × 0.52 kcal/g ≈ 10 kcal.
- Blackberries: 28 g × 0.43 kcal/g ≈ 12 kcal.
- Crumbs: about 8 kcal.
- Total: about 30 kcal.
